verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions OTLP, OpenTelemetry SDKs, or native OTLP ingestion endpoints in Grafana; the closest reference is sending logs to Loki via Grafana Alloy, which is an indirect, unrelated mention rather than documentation of first-class OTLP support in Grafana itself. Tracing/metrics docs (Tempo) discuss traces and exemplars but do not describe OTLP as a supported ingestion protocol.
